era_notes.pike: General Order 1 is explicitly referred to as the Prime Directive in 2259.
era_notes.kirk: Core ethical and operational rule in TOS and films.
era_notes.tng_ds9_voyager: Highly developed body of doctrine with extensive interpretation and case history.

rules: Warp capability is not a universal automatic-contact trigger.
First Contact remains governed by non-interference, self-determination and local political/cultural readiness.
Accidental contamination creates a mitigation problem; it does not erase the Prime Directive.
